note: Hong Kong's Immigration Department table of visa and entry permit requirements by nationality: the visa-free period for a visit (7 to 180 days: 180 for British citizens, 90 for British overseas territories' citizens and most of Europe and the Americas) or a visa always required; nationals of countries the table doesn't name may visit for 7 days without a visa; Indians stay 14 days after a free online pre-arrival registration (taken as an ETA). Mainland residents need an exit-entry permit with an endorsement from the Mainland authorities beforehand (Basic Law art. 22(4); taken as a visa); Macao permanent residents visit up to 180 days without a permit; Taiwan residents register online before arrival, free (taken as an ETA; those holding the Mainland Travel Permit for Taiwan Residents may stay 30 days). Variants the table refuses (Albania's and Serbia's non-biometric passports, special Peruvian, Tongan national, I-Tuvalu passports) aren't modelled; stateless travellers need a visa.
